load_data_squad: load preprocessed SQuAD examples from a JSON lines file with optional case normalization
build_word_dict: build a word dictionary from question and document words in provided SQuAD examples
f1_score_exact_match: compute the F1 score and exact match score between a prediction and ground truth answer
normalize_answer: normalize an answer string by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
average_meter_timer: use the AverageMeter class to track running averages and the Timer class to measure elapsed time
